content:
emma: Morning — short exec weekly. Key asks for this week: 1) Private EU beta launch readiness 2) Update to data retention policy (regs) 3) Post-incident follow-ups from Friday spike. TL;DR: launch on track, small policy tweak incoming, postmortem in progress.

rajiv: Thanks — can you confirm whether the policy change affects nightly backups?

lina: We need SOC sign-off before auto-enforcing retention. Looping in @security. :shield:

vp_prod: Can infra guarantee the canary window for the EU beta won't impact hosted API SLOs? Need a short risk doc.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled: private-eu-beta v1.2 -> canary on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (region: eu-west-1). Notifying oncall.

sasha: Quick incident summary (Friday 03:45-04:10 UTC): API p95->p99 spike, requests queued due to aggressive batching change + unexpected KV cache churn. Mitigation: rolled back batching tweak and increased cache TTL for hotspots. No customer data exposure. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-01-e2e-spike

emma: Good summary — appreciate the quick rollback. Action items: 1) infra to add a pre-rollout SLO impact check (owner: vp_prod) 2) eng-runtime to add automated cache-eviction telemetry (owner: rajiv) 3) legal/compliance + security to sign the retention policy language (owner: security).

vp_prod: I'll own the SLO impact check, will draft a one-pager template by EOD Wednesday.

rajiv: Will add eviction telemetry — putting a PR up today with metrics + dashboard alerts.

security: We'll review retention draft and flag anything with cross-border implications. ETA Tues.

emma: Policy excerpt (draft) below — comments welcome. Please reply in-thread or on the doc.

```
Retention change (draft):
- Default user request logs: 30 days -> 14 days
- Admin audit logs: 365 days -> 540 days
- Backups: Snapshots retained for 90 days (customer-managed retention preserved)
- EU customer data: never leave EU regions unless explicitly opted-in by customer
```

lina: Minor nit — recommend keeping request logs 21 days for troubleshooting. Otherwise looks OK.

rajiv: Noted re: 21 days — will flag metric retention tradeoffs in my PR.

ops_lead: Canary runbook updated with rollback steps and traffic fencing. Will run a tabletop on Thursday.

emma: Two asks before Friday: 1) owners confirm they can meet their ETA 2) SRE to schedule a brief canary watch (2 people for first hour). Thanks — big week. :rocket:

vp_prod: Confirming ETA.

infra-bot: Oncall reminder: watch party -> 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC to 03:30 UTC.

sasha: Postmortem will include timeline + action plan, will post final by Tue COB.

emma: Appreciate it. If anyone has blockers to their action items ping me directly. Let's keep this tight. :eyes:

rajiv: ack.

lina: ack.

security: ack — will update once review done.

ops_lead: ack and prepping tabletop.

emma: Thanks team. Short pulse next Monday if anything changes.
